note: Twelve synthetic base Aufsichtsarbeiten (tech doc 7.1). Every item is written for this project. No school items, no published Pruefungsfragen, no scraped practice questions. This is a compliance boundary, not a convenience: it is what makes the non-EU free-tier providers usable at all (tech doc 6.2, 9).

sets.intent: well-formed and varied; the false-flag baseline. These should produce few or no flags.
sound construction across different Versorgungsbereiche; second false-flag baseline.
organically weak construction, as an inexperienced author would produce it. Not mutations: these are whole items written badly.
exercises the precondition gate and the cross-item rule. D-01 is an unfinished draft; all three share Versorgungsbereich and Altersgruppe.

known_weaknesses.comment: Recorded here rather than in the items, so the items read like real drafts. These are the organic defects the catalogue should find; they are separate from the harness-generated mutations, whose ground truth lives in mutations/ (tech doc 7.2).

C-01.defect: Fallsituation is one 90-word Schachtelsatz with nested relative clauses and a double negation
ta.1 declares 8 Punkte, its Erwartungshorizont sums to 6; ta.2 and ta.3 also mismatch
ta.2 contains no operator at all, only a nominalised instruction
'zweiundachtzig' and 'fuenf' written as number words in the Fallsituation
ta.1 asks for 'Massnahmen' with no count
Fallsituation is largely in the werden-passive

C-02.defect: ta.1 uses the Anforderungsbereich-I operator 'nennen' but declares Anforderungsniveau III
ta.1 asks to name causes; its Erwartungshorizont rewards begruenden, bewerten and ableiten
Schuhgroesse, parents' occupations, the dog, and the renovated living room are used by no Teilaufgabe

C-03.defect: ta.1 carries two operators: 'Nennen Sie ... und bewerten Sie diese'
ta.1 declares 8 Punkte, its Erwartungshorizont sums to 8 but ta.1's first point is weighted 2 against a 3-point pattern
every Teilaufgabe declares Anforderungsniveau I, so the distribution is degenerate
ta.2 claims I.2.g, which exists in Anlage 1 but not in Anlage 2 — the only such code in the catalogue

declared Pruefungsbereich 3 requires I.3, I.4, II.3, III.2; the claimed codes cover only I.3 (via ta.1), with I.2.g, IV.1.a and II.1.a all outside the required set -- 1 of 4 Schwerpunkte, below the KOMP-03B majority threshold. Does not trigger KOMP-03 itself, since the intersection is non-empty.

D-01.defect: no Erwartungshorizont and only 2 of an intended 4 Teilaufgaben. FORM-06, FORM-07 and QUELL-* must emit NotChecked, never a flag (tech doc 1.5.1).

D-02_D-03.defect: D-01, D-02 and D-03 are all stationaer_langzeit with altersgruppe alter_mensch, so the sibling set does not vary as § 14 Absatz 2 requires
